svg.title: A column addition in binary. Row n writes Euler's totient phi(n) in binary with its last digit in place n after the binary point, for n from 1 to 20 (rows continue below); a hatched cell is a digit 1, a dot a digit 0. The rows form a slowly widening diagonal band of overlapping digits that carry into each other. Under the rule, the binary digits of the sum S = 1.3676..., 1.0101111000011101 and so on, in no visible pattern. Ringed in ember, changes of at most 2 to phi(n) at seven even n; with them, and similar changes further on, the sum is exactly 5/4, whose binary digits 1.01 are followed by zeros only.
svg.text: place k after the binary point, worth 1/2k
